## Issue Category

- [ ] README link broken or missing
- [ ] Skill frontmatter missing or malformed
- [ ] Skill content mismatches title or domain
- [ ] Duplicate skill or boundary conflict
- [ ] CI / Installer script issue
- [ ] Other repository issue

## Affected File(s) or Path(s)

Please specify the path, for example:

`skills/power-hardware-engineer/SKILL.md`

## Description

Please clearly describe what issue you encountered, why it is problematic, and what the expected behavior should be.

## Additional Context

Add any relevant screenshots, terminal logs, or suggested solutions here.
